sourceBadge.label: Quiet Reflection: An ability triggers until end of turn

notes: Human paid hand play establishes the named-source repeating trigger. Two independent materializations each queue and resolve source i1 and draw exactly once. Source i1 printing UUID is checked in effectStarted and triggerQueued events; duration persists through both draws and expires at Ending. Named source and duration appear in the badge accessible name and battle log. Caps empty. Existing log close control is exercised before expiry. Captures certify duration icon and log copy, without settled battlefield-card geometry claims.
